title: SkillsPreview
description: Result of skills.preview — what a person reads before deciding whether to install a skill somebody else wrote. Nothing has been written to disk when this is returned; a refusal comes back as a JSON-RPC error naming the step that refused.

name.description: The skill's name, taken from the document's frontmatter and matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$. The URL's path never names a skill.

description.description: The frontmatter description, which is what the assistant is offered on every ask.

body.description: The WHOLE body, frontmatter stripped. A person adopting instructions reads all of them; an excerpt is not something anybody can approve responsibly.

url.description: The address that was fetched, as the person gave it — never a redirect target.

findings.description: EVERY static-scan match in the body, in pattern order, never only the first: the 8 KiB bound that makes the assistant's write path attach one finding belongs to a tool result, not to a dialog. Never null: no matches is []. A finding is evidence and never a refusal.

items.description: One scan match. The three fields are the ones agent.approvalRequested already declares for a finding, because two shapes for one fact is how they come to disagree; they are inlined rather than named so the generated renderer type has no second export nothing consumes.
